P.text: In `_validateSignature`, after `ECDSA.tryRecover`, the `InvalidSignatureS` branch is reached when the `s` component of a signature falls in the upper half of the secp256k1 curve order (high-s signature); a high-s counterpart can be derived from any valid owner signature via `s' = curve_order - s` with identical recovered address.
P.evidence_quote: `RecoverError.InvalidSignatureS` is triggered by OpenZeppelin's ECDSA library when the `s` component of a signature falls in the upper half of the secp256k1 curve order (high-s signature).

I.text: ERC-4337 requires validating the signature of the userOpHash and SHOULD return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (1) without reverting on signature mismatch; the `InvalidSignature` branch correctly returns `_packValidationData(true, ...)` (SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED).
I.evidence_quote: "MUST validate that the signature is a valid signature of the userOpHash, and SHOULD return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (1) without reverting on signature mismatch."

V.text: The `InvalidSignatureS` branch unconditionally reverts instead of returning SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED; during on-chain `handleOps` execution the EntryPoint calls `validateUserOp` without a try/catch, so a revert propagates through the entire bundle, causing the bundler's transaction to fail.
V.evidence_quote: However, the `InvalidSignatureS` branch unconditionally reverts instead.
